brief.analystNote: BTC holds Phase C at $83,529 — 5% into the $81,475–$122,272 range — supported by LTH accumulation at +7,637 BTC/day, ETF inflows of $347M above the $264M institutional baseline, and a structurally weak DXY at 99.79. The 10Y yield at 5.11% remains the primary macro headwind and is sufficient on its own to suppress risk appetite if it continues climbing toward 5.25–5.50%. The CLARITY Act stall in the Senate is a near-term regulatory overhang that has removed a potential 2026 catalyst from the near-term timeline — institutional allocators who were waiting on regulatory clarity may remain on the sidelines until the Senate path becomes visible again. MVRV of 1.18 confirms we remain in fair value territory with no distribution signal, and the CME basis at +30.87% reflects genuine institutional interest, though the 1-day expiry caveat makes this reading noisy — monitor the October contract basis post-roll Friday. Market regime is flagged as NORMAL with insufficient anchor history (10 cycles vs 120+ required for full confidence), meaning phase anchors carry somewhat wider uncertainty bands than a mature cycle system would produce; this warrants maintaining the 20% DCA cash reserve as a buffer against anchor slippage.
brief.riskWarning: 10Y Treasury yield breaches 5.25%+ on strong economic data or hawkish Fed communication, triggering simultaneous risk-off in equities and BTC, invalidating the MVRV fair value hold thesis and accelerating a retest of $79,703 (20d SMA) or the $81,475 Phase C floor.
